purpose: Title 标题; reference Gallery contract with the documented necessary accessibility color exception (docs/DESIGN.md).

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandTitle](../../lib/src/components/title.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list. Widget/span slots are opaque and must not be inspected or rewritten.
interface.outputs: User intent callbacks; host decides whether to commit controlled state.
interface.state_model: Controlled values are authoritative. Component owns only focus, hover, preview, motion and explicitly uncontrolled state.
interface.events: A child action dispatches once and does not activate its ancestor.
interface.composition: Host owns placement and occupied layout constraints. Title owns its horizontally intrinsic surface, which may overflow those constraints to preserve the reference nowrap layout. A constraint-dependent opaque child must supply its own finite width; explicit child styles, keys, actions and semantics remain authoritative. Gallery-owned alert callbacks use the shared route; this does not move business callback ownership into the component. Modal Tab traversal consumes forward and reverse keys even when a closed loop keeps the same target or contains no actions. One shared boundary in the existing action module delegates order to the existing FocusScope, owns one skipped non-semantic target for an otherwise empty scope, and removes its borrowed-scope listener and owned node on disposal. It does not inspect children, add another FocusScope or replace a caller-owned focus target. IslandDialogRoute now defaults explicitly to TraversalEdgeBehavior.closedLoop; an explicitly supplied non-closed-loop policy, including null inheritance from Navigator, remains authoritative. Drawer, Loading, showIslandModal and the shared preview/alert route consume this same behavior. Actual Web keyboard and Windows/AT validation remain separate from widget tests.
interface.accessibility: Named controls, states and keyboard actions. Screen-reader execution and validation are excluded by the user scope decision on 2026-10-17; named semantics and keyboard contracts remain required.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese Gallery; host content and inherited directionality.
interface.async_behavior: Host owns business requests. Timers, routes and presentation state are disposed by their creator.
interface.lifecycle: Borrowed controllers and focus nodes are never disposed by consumers.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned product palette with component-owned state recipes; documented accessibility color differences under docs/DESIGN.md. Existing contrast thresholds remain. Explicit child styles win; no opaque-child inspection, parallel palette or Gallery-only imitation. Global readable-motion authority: docs/DESIGN.md. Component-specific state and lifecycle rules remain with their owners; every transition retains the existing contrast budgets. Owned readable text roles also set default icon roles. Fixed light content surfaces scope light semantic roles for nested public controls; explicit child styles and unrelated ThemeExtensions remain unchanged. Known owned surfaces reuse LightSurfaceScope with a component-supplied paired foreground for nested public controls; no background guessing or child rewriting. Scope topology stays stable on filled/transparent Tag changes. Explicit child styles, unrelated ThemeExtensions, keys, state and focus remain authoritative. Custom backgrounds require a caller-owned suitable foreground. The fixed foundation paired foregrounds also cover nested text-button pressed beige and ghost-button8% mint hover composition. Nine onAccent, seven Title and three patterned-paper foreground entries were deepened after396 measured failing frame checks across1092 recipes; fills, hover overlays and motion are retained. The complete old/new pairs and actual backings are registered under A11Y-023; static default contrast is not a substitute for these state checks. Title foreground comes from its independent titlePalette across ribbon/layer/tab and every size. Independent Title role decisions and applicability follow docs/DESIGN.md#title-foreground; state-specific evidence remains in the audit record. Front/back/fold artwork and hover mechanism are unchanged; default nested Text Button pressed/focus pairs retain the original budgets. Gallery captions and Title content retain their declared separate role owners.
interface.migration: Fresh implementation; no old-library compatibility track.

scenarios.given: The pinned reference page and its recorded sections
scenarios.when: Capture the same viewport and interaction state
scenarios.then: Layout, typography, geometry, assets and motion agree; necessary accessibility color differences are registered against actual states/backgrounds under docs/DESIGN.md, and other differences remain failures. User-approved readable-motion deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md with no transition exemption.

scenarios.when: A child acts or a parent rebuilds/reorders/rejects a proposal
scenarios.then: No event bubbling, style overwrite, selection-index substitution or ownership violation.

scenarios.given: A positive logical border and the local MediaQuery DPR
scenarios.when: The component or its Gallery reference frame resolves a border
scenarios.then: IslandTheme.borderWidth is the unique owner: whole physical pixels rounded down, minimum one physical pixel. DPR1 appearance is retained; text line boxes and counts are not border metrics.

scenarios.given: A fixed owned surface in either host theme with a nested public transparent action and an opaque keyed child
scenarios.when: Palette, hover/press/focus, host theme or filled/transparent variant changes
scenarios.then: Default necessary text stays at4.5 against its actual backing and required strokes at3; explicit styles, callback isolation, child state and focus survive. No whole-subtree fade or rewrite.

scenarios.given: Title is opaque caller-supplied content inside a caller-owned modal route with zero/one/multiple actions; Title owns no modal route or traversal scope.
scenarios.when: Forward/reverse Tab, activation, dismissal, rejected close or owner removal occurs
scenarios.then: Closed loops consume Tab without leaving the modal; callbacks fire once and accepted close restores origin. Explicit route traversal overrides survive, opaque child identity/styles remain, and owned focus resources are cleaned up.
